result.answer: The U.S. Justice Department has filed a civil fraud lawsuit accusing Renova Group, founded by Viktor Vekselberg, of violating sanctions by routing payments through its affiliate Columbus Nova. The suit alleges $583,332.98 in illicit transfers and seeks damages and injunctive relief.
